195:t_018:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We've taken our first step forward.」

195:t_018:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「How about a giant stride next?」

195:t_018:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We'll use this base as a foothold to attack the capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$...」

195:t_018:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Once we take the capital, their chain of command will be severed. Then we can defeat them one by one.」

195:t_018:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So the next battle will decide Earth's fate.」

195:t_018:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「That makes joining up with you worthwhile.」

195:t_018:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's go, everyone. Let's take this Earth back from $$サイデリアル$$.」

195:t_019:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The enemy force has been confirmed destroyed.」

195:t_019:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We've taken our first step forward.」

195:t_019:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「How about a giant stride next?」

195:t_019:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We'll use this base as a foothold to attack the capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$...」

195:t_019:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Once we take the capital, their chain of command will be severed. Then we can defeat them one by one.」

195:t_019:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So the next battle will decide Earth's fate.」

195:t_019:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「That makes joining up with you worthwhile.」

195:t_019:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's go, everyone. Let's take this Earth back from $$サイデリアル$$.」

195:t_020:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The transport is leaving the area!」

195:t_020:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We must stop the remaining ships! Prioritize deploying our most mobile units!」

195:t_021:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The enemy ship's engine is damaged! It's making an emergency landing!」

195:t_021:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Send $$エコーズ$$! Rescue the civilians who were being held aboard!」

195:t_022:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The last enemy ship has stopped!」

195:t_022:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「We did it! Now everyone's been rescued!」

195:t_022:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We just need to finish off the remaining enemy units. I'm counting on you.」

195:t_023:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then... all of this was for nothing...」

195:t_024:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Th-this is bad...! This blunder is truly disastrous!」

195:t_025:0.en:
$n
「That guy... He always says the same sort of thing when he runs away...」

195:t_025:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Still, they keep putting him in command. Maybe he's actually capable.」

195:t_025:2.en:
$n
「If that's true, the Empire must have a serious shortage of talent.」

195:t_026:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Huh... That $$ノリコ$$ girl uses the same move as $$ノノ$$.」

195:t_026:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What are you saying, $$ニコラ$$!? $$ノノ$$'s Inazuma Kick is much cooler!」

195:t_026:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Listen! I won't let you mock the Inazuma Reversal Kick, a $$沖ジョ$$ tradition!」

195:t_026:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What are those two doing with the enemy right in front of us...?」

195:t_027:1.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Sorry, bro. I got in your way.」

195:t_027:2.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Man, I just can't catch a break. I was working hard collecting debts, and the Empire grabbed me...」

195:t_027:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Save your life story and get out of here! It's dangerous!」

195:t_027:4.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Sorry, bro. To make up for the trouble, take this! I swiped it from the Empire!」

195:t_028:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Are you sure!? This is quite a treasure!」

195:t_028:1.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Don't worry about it! Life's the greatest treasure of all!」

195:t_028:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「I like that line! I like you, pal!」

195:t_028:3.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Same here, my man! I, $$ゼニトリー・マッセ$$, will keep collecting debts with purity and righteousness!」

195:t_029:1.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Sorry, sis. I got in your way.」

195:t_029:2.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Man, I just can't catch a break. I was working hard collecting debts, and the Empire grabbed me...」

195:t_029:3.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Sis... Do you want to hear my life story?」

195:t_029:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「L-let's leave that for another time. Please get out of here first!」

195:t_029:5.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Will do! To make up for the trouble, take this! I swiped it from the Empire!」

195:t_030:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...Are you sure? That part looks very expensive...」

195:t_030:1.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Don't worry about it! You saved my life!」

195:t_030:2.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「I, $$ゼニトリー・マッセ$$, will keep collecting debts with purity and righteousness!」

195:t_030:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
(People with shaved heads... always seem full of energy.)

195:t_031:2.en:
$$獣人$$
「It's been a while, Captain $$ヴィラル$$! Man, am I glad to see you!」

195:t_031:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「Is this the time for a carefree chat!? Get out of here!」

195:t_031:4.en:
$$獣人$$
「You're $$シモン$$ of the $$大グレン団$$!?」

195:t_031:5.en:
$$獣人$$
「Yeah... I'm sure you can put my treasure to good use.」

195:t_032:1.en:
$$獣人$$
「See ya! Don't let him beat you, $$シモン$$ the Digger!」

195:t_032:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Heh... It looks like he fought $$カミナ$$ and you when you were a kid.」

195:t_032:3.en:
$$シモン$$
(I'll do it, Bro...! I'll become a man worthy of these sunglasses!)

195:t_100:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「War is bullshit! Listen to my song!!」

195:t_100:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
(That's right, $$バサラ$$. That's just how you should be.)

195:t_100:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
(War is certainly pointless. That's why we soldiers fight to end it as quickly as we can.)

195:t_101:0.en:
$$アルト$$
($$ランカ$$... What on earth happened to you...?)

195:t_101:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(Damn it...! This isn't the time to worry about $$ミカゲ$$'s nightmare...!)

195:t_102:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Big Sis... Now that I've recovered $$ガンバスター$$, I'll fight with everything I have...)

195:t_102:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(My own fire, and the fire I inherited from you... I'll combine them into a blazing flame!)

195:t_102:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Stop spacing out, $$ノノ$$! If you're aboard $$ディスヌフ$$, I'll put you to work!」

195:t_102:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Y-yes! $$ノノ$$ will do her best alongside Big Sis!」

195:t_102:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「With the hard work and guts $$ノノリリ$$ taught me!」

195:t_103:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「I have a huge score to settle with $$サイデリアル$$...!」

195:t_103:1.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Yeah...! For everyone waiting on the $$新世界大陸$$ too, we have to defeat them!」

195:t_103:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Today is a preliminary battle before the showdown! Don't slip up, $$シモン$$!」
